name: Chris Tham
headline: Strategy Consultant | Technology Strategy, Architecture and Business Change
summary: Founder of Hello Tham, a boutique strategy consulting company. Available for short to medium term consulting engagements spanning strategic business change, business and operating model design, business process improvement, and technology strategy, architecture and solutions.

achievements.title: Flexible strategic change agent and thought leader
achievements.detail: Led IT strategies and operating models for Transport for NSW, Transfield Services, ING, NAB and MLC. Founder of Hello Tham, delivering strategy, architecture and operating model engagements since 2016.

achievements.title: Successful and proven technology strategy and architecture leader
achievements.detail: Enterprise Architect at Cochlear, defining the architecture service model, EA metrics framework and federated architecture governance. Head of Architecture roles at NAB and MLC; consultant for HP and AT&T/NCR.

achievements.title: Recognised technology innovator and industry expert
achievements.detail: Shaped Cochlear's AI Reference Architecture and agentic AI guardrails; pioneered AI/ML dashboards, omni-channel self-service chatbots and service-oriented architectures. Lecturer in Information Systems at Torrens University and author of AI-dō.
